metadata.title: Candid Group Portrait with Scribble Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, overexposed candid group portrait featuring hand-drawn, scribbled display typography in the upper margin.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist corporate photography is required
serif or sans-serif clean typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring three men laughing inside a vintage vehicle, characterized by blown-out highlights, deep shadows, and a prominent title rendered in a messy, ballpoint-pen scribble style.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography floats in the bright negative space of the upper third
Subject faces are illuminated by harsh, directional light
Foreground car seat creates a dark, textured anchor at the bottom
Cool blue tones in the car frame contrast with warm skin tones
coreInvariants: Scribbled, multi-stroke texture for all display characters
High-key overexposure in the background elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, filling the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, ribbed texture of the car seat in the immediate foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the scribbled text top-left, moves down to the central laughing face, then sweeps across to the other two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright, overexposed area in the top third and between the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright white and overexposed light blue (background/sky)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy (foreground shadows and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low saturation in the environment and high saturation in the shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to naturalistic skin tones and mechanical blues/blacks

letterConstructionRules: Each letter is formed by dense, overlapping circular and vertical scribbles
Varying line weight mimicking a ballpoint pen or fine-liner
Irregular edges with stray 'sketch' lines extending beyond the letter boundaries
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'f' and 'l' characters have elongated, messy ascenders
The 's' characters are composed of tight, chaotic loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative style; no secondary typeface.

candidateDirections.reason: To mimic the hand-drawn, messy ink quality
Matches the informal, raw aesthetic of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, overexposed photo of three men laughing inside a vintage car with blue interior; the top third should be mostly blown-out white light.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom black scribble-style lettering in the top-left corner using a messy, multi-stroke pen effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text composed of messy scribbles rather than solid lines?
Are the subjects' expressions candid and laughing?
Is the foreground anchored by a dark, textured element?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the car
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or logo
Do not replicate the exact faces of the individuals

mustAchieve: High-key lighting that bleeds into the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible despite the scribble style
Ensure the overexposure doesn't wash out the facial features entirely
Verify the foreground seat provides enough visual weight at the bottom
Confirm the color palette remains grounded in blues and warm skin tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Candid lifestyle photography + Overexposed high-key lighting + Scribble-texture display typography.
